mediaProfile: Exact optional S10 value; absence is legacy900 on both sides, mismatch is unknown. Never infer/upgrade/default a different profile.
authentication: Authenticate provided body streamKey against explicit ORIGINAL sourceId before ledger classification; wrong key/source, unavailable original credential proof or authorization failure is generic denied/unknown, never terminal. No raw keys/tokens in durable metadata/logs. Plugin owns per-output pinned credential reference.
ledger: Hard require exact source_id+output_id row; then actor/generation and original recording/capture_intent/epoch/profile plus stable bind receipt. No target/direct fallback. No provider/client client-check can substitute server preconditions.
receipt: Must equal original operationKey=outputSessionId+.bind, operation=bind and completed K4 wire receipt, including any present commandId. Existing repository bind receipt is persisted accepted, while K4 OpenBroadcastOutput explicitly renders State=completed after successful binding. Derive exactly this completed wire receipt ONLY after verifying existing fully-bound ledger/capture/binding; do not update stored receipt or invent completion for an incomplete intent.
active: 200 data.state=active only after all original auth/ledger/pins/profile/receipt exact AND same durable original capture.input_active=true AND no deleted/revoked/terminal/generation-retired conflict; echo same identity/profile/receipt and issue session only. A conflicting terminal label while input remains active is UNKNOWN, never active/terminal by guess.
terminal: 200 data.state=terminal ONLY after original source authentication AND exact existing original(source,output) ledger AND complete verifiable original recording/capture-intent/capture/epoch/profile/stable completed wire receipt match AND the SAME existing original capture row durably has input_active=false. Deletion/revocation/terminal/generation-retired labels ALONE are insufficient. Missing capture/ledger/nullable or unprovable occupancy remains UNKNOWN. This is output-input lifecycle retirement, not media deletion/completion. Echo exact pins/receipt, NEVER session, retire only original local output, preserve media/journal/receipt; explicit new user Start still passes global server guard.
unknown: Missing/incomplete ledger, mismatch, unavailable proof, timeout or any non-200/malformed/unsupported response is UNKNOWN. Recommended server409 code broadcast_output_replay_unknown after auth for ledger/pin uncertainty. Generic401/403/404, any409 error including broadcast_output_terminal, and rollback404 are NEVER terminal in K5.
crossFieldValidation: all outer identity/profile fields exactly original durable ledger/binding
a source credential must authenticate the explicitly supplied original sourceId; no current global-key source retarget
terminal additionally requires same existing original capture.input_active=false; active requires true and no conflicting authority
noSideEffects: No source target/direct resolution or ensureDirectTx
No queue/media deletion/cleanup or publication/notification/outbox writes
No input_active/prepared mutation; original global new-output capacity guard unchanged
HTTPBoundary: Existing trusted gateway Dapr caller requirement, no account/JWT spoofing; new exact admin-host POST4KiB/no query/no cookies/strip Authorization/no upstream retry/private-no-store. Invalid payload400, protocol422, auth401/403, missing route404, authenticated unknown409, throttle429 RetryAfter, dependency503; all errors UNKNOWN.
oldServerAndRollback: New route absent returns404 through old CMS/Gateway; plugin stays conservative and never falls back. CMS→Gateway→plugin order. K4/S10 frozen files/schemas unchanged.
testsRequiredBeforeImplementationClaim: Service+PG hard original ledger/no writes on missing/incomplete/mismatch/changed global key
Fully bound active exact response and terminal proof after deletion/key generation/input inactive; no provider/outbox calls
Concurrent creation vs replay uses existing source/recording lock order and leaves global input guard intact
Plugin original profile/receipt/key references, malformed success/error/rollback404 never retire/create; only matched terminal retires original output, no media/oldqueue deletion

Deleted/revoked/terminal/generation-retired while input_active=true must be UNKNOWN; missing capture/ledger or incomplete seal proof UNKNOWN; false only on exact original capture may terminal; never release another source/capture
fixtureData: All UUIDs/key/session values are synthetic schema examples, not production credentials or identifiers.
inputReleasePredicate: Read existing generated hhc_web.member_recording_capture.input_active on the exact capture-intent row linked by original ledger; require row exists and value=false for terminal. Do NOT update flags, call abort, finish intents, delete queues, mutate source or create captures to obtain this proof. Capture.Terminal/recording.deleted_at/b.Revoked/key generation are not substitutes.

sourceReleaseTransactions.proof: input_active is GENERATED ALWAYS from capture_input_active(active,payload_json,broadcast_epoch). It is false when active=false, or fully evidenced B1 normal seal (NormalEnd+StopAcceptedAt+positiveSealedEndSequence+freezing/validating+nonpending matching accepted seal receipt). No new SQL/migration is needed.

Same transaction sets recording.deleted_at, calls closeCapturePublicationTx(...,now) which Terminate(aborted,recording_deleted) then saveCapture writes active=false/payload; generated input_active=false before source target clearing and commit. Raw historical deleted_at-only does NOT establish release; existing TestBroadcastSourceCleanupOfHistoricalDeletionKeepsInputOccupied proves this.

Cancel refuses c.Active() or existing start boundary; sets revoked/blocked/cancelled but does not itself terminate/release active input. cancel-command/emergency-close/ClosePublication also do NOT prove release; replay must inspect exact durable input_active row.

After trusted provider seal response, stores NormalEnd, positive SealedEndSequence, merged freezing/validating status and matching accepted receipt with Pending=false, then saveCapture/commit atomically derives input_active=false. Local stop alone or pending/missing receipt remains occupied.

sourceReleaseTransactions.proof: Terminate sets terminal state, existing saveCapture writes active=false, generated input_active=false. K5 replay NEVER invokes these transitions; it only reads their already committed result. ready state likewise Active=false when saved.
